notes: User-confirmed inclusive dates and weekly slots; exclude Vienna school holidays and Austrian public holidays for every slot.
Times are local Europe/Vienna wall-clock times, not UTC instants. recurring_day uses Sunday=0.
Official Vienna school-free days Allerseelen and Hl. Leopold are also excluded; neither is an Austrian nationwide public holiday.
Vienna lists Semesterferien from 30 January; the federal ministry lists 1 February. These differ only by a weekend and exclude the same training slots.
School-autonomous closures and school-specific exceptions are unknown and are NOT guessed. In particular, 7 January and 7 and 28 May remain scheduled unless separately confirmed.
No capacity was confirmed: new sessions have max_capacity=null. Existing descriptions, capacities, cancellations and season settings are never overwritten.

vienna.title: Bildungsdirektion Wien: Schuljahr 2026/2027
vienna.scope: Exact Vienna holiday ranges, dated public holidays, Allerseelen, Hl. Leopold, school-year end and school-autonomous-day caveat.

education.title: Bundesministerium für Bildung: Schulferien 2026/2027
education.scope: Independent official confirmation of school holiday dates; school-specific exceptions are possible.

public_holiday_law.title: RIS: Arbeitsruhegesetz, § 7 Abs. 2
public_holiday_law.scope: Exhaustive Austrian statutory public holiday names; fixed calendar dates and Easter/Pentecost Mondays. Movable dates are confirmed by the official Vienna calendar.

vienna_school_law.title: RIS: Wiener Schulgesetz, § 56 Abs. 4, 5 and 7
vienna_school_law.scope: Allerseelen and 15 November are statutory school-free days. Additional bridge days and 7 January require separate declarations; no school-specific dates are inferred.

autonomous_days.title: Bundesministerium für Bildung: Herbstferien
autonomous_days.scope: Allerseelen remains school-free; Easter/Pentecost Tuesdays are normally school days; school-specific autonomous days and opt-outs cannot be inferred.
